notes:
Source: SUTRAM Ilhéus official consolidated timetable PDF (HorariosOnibus_Ilheus, in force 2022-02-21), the only source that parsed. The two city per-line PDFs (linha 25/38) and the two UESC PDFs were behind a Cloudflare challenge / returned corrupted binary and could not be extracted. The SUTRAM PDF lists every trip with columns SAÍDA(origin) / HORÁRIO(dep) / EMPRESA(operator) / LINHA(line) / VIA(corridor) / CENTRO(time passing Terminal Urbano/Centro) / DESTINO / TIPO DIA. Operator VM = Via Metro (the co-operator SM = Transportes Urbanos São Miguel de Ilhéus was excluded per the task). Extracted 424 VM trips across 14 lines (01,03,06,09,12,13,15,16,23,30,31,41,44,61), all DIAS ÚTEIS (weekday). Full weekday departure lists were captured; the feed emits 221 trips total (all real published departures) with 884 stop_times, of which the representative subset below carries one trip per line per direction (28 trips, 112 stop_times) — the full set is in /home/ubuntu/adresses/ilheus_gtfs/*.txt.

STOP MODEL: the PDF only gives named termini + one VIA corridor + the fact that every trip passes Terminal Urbano (Centro). Each trip is therefore modeled as a 4-point sequence: origin terminus -> VIA corridor point -> Terminal Urbano (Centro) -> destination terminus. Real intermediate bus_stop nodes are NOT enumerated in the source, so only evidenced named places are used (no invented stops).

TIMES: origin = published SAÍDA; Terminal Urbano = published CENTRO time; the VIA point is linearly interpolated between them; the post-Centro leg to the far terminus is extrapolated at the same pace (these two legs are estimates, the two anchor times are from the schedule).

COORDINATES: WGS-84 from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, place=suburb/village nodes within/near Ilhéus admin_level=8) for Cidade Nova, Iguape, Olivença, Basílio, Conquista, Nelson Costa, Hernani Sá, Nossa Senhora da Vitória, São Domingos, Teotônio Vilela, Salobrinho, Terminal Urbano (amenity=bus_station), UESC. Condomínio Sol e Mar (~Rod. Ilhéus-Buerarema Km03, N.Sra da Vitória/zona sul), Cururupe, Residencial Vilela, and the avenue via-points (Av. Itabuna, Av. Canavieiras, Av. Princesa Isabel) are approximate coordinates from geocoding/known district location. Timezone America/Bahia (BRT, no DST).

Files: /home/ubuntu/adresses/ilheus_gtfs/{agency,stops,routes,trips,stop_times,calendar}.txt (full 221-trip feed) + main.txt (extracted source).

Confidence 0.62: line list, directions, termini, VIA corridors and all departure/Centro times are faithful to the official SUTRAM PDF; the intermediate stop granularity (only 4 evidenced points per trip) and the non-anchor interpolated times are the main fidelity gaps, plus 4 stop coordinates are approximate. Saturday/Sunday service is not in the source (VM trips are all weekday).
